description: OpenAPI 3 surface-change reports and a single-param stateful monitor: GET /monitor?url=<your openapi.json> stores a baseline and returns only what changed on the next call. POST /compare compares two specs; /batch up to 25 pairs. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/api-change-check/batch

url.description: Public http(s) URL of a JSON OpenAPI 3 document. The monitor derives its baseline token from this URL, so repeat calls with the same URL return only what changed.

name: api_change_check__batch
